aids.description_en: Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah (STR) cash transfer for low-income households. Amounts (2025): MYR 1,000 (household income < MYR 2,500/month), MYR 800 (household income MYR 2,501-4,999), additional MYR 500 per eligible child under 18. Maximum household MYR 2,800/year. Paid in 3 instalments via Maybank2u or PosMalaysia. Source: str.hasil.gov.my.
aids.organisme: Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri (LHDN) / Kementerian Kewangan

aids.description_en: Employees Provident Fund (EPF/KWSP): mandatory retirement savings. Employer contributes 13% (income <= MYR 5,000) or 12% of salary. Employee contributes 11% (9% for employees above 60). Withdrawals allowed at 55 (Account 1 — locked) and 50 (Account 2 — partial). Dividends: 5-7% per year. Source: kwsp.gov.my.

Social Security Organisation (SOCSO/PERKESO): work accident and invalidity coverage. Permanent disability pension: 50-80% of daily wage x 1,800 (Employment Injury Scheme). Temporary disability allowance: 100% of daily insured wage. Maximum insured wage MYR 5,000/month. Employee 0.5% + employer 1.75% of salary. Source: perkeso.gov.my.

Employment Insurance System (EIS): unemployment benefit 60-80% of last insured wage for up to 6 months. Maximum insured wage MYR 4,000/month → max benefit MYR 3,200/month. Funded by employee 0.2% + employer 0.2% of salary. Also covers job search allowance and training fees. Source: perkeso.gov.my (Employment Insurance System Act 2017).

aids.nom: Bantuan Am (JKM) — Aide sociale (Jabatan Kebajikan Masyarakat)
aids.description_en: JKM social welfare assistance for poor households: MYR 350-450/month per household depending on family composition. Additional support: MYR 200/month per elderly member (if not receiving other pension), school transport, medical aid. Household income ceiling MYR 1,500/month. Source: jkm.gov.my.

aids.nom: Bantuan Warga Emas — Allocation personnes agees
aids.description_en: Elderly assistance for low-income Malaysians aged 60+: MYR 500/month (2025). Target: elderly not receiving EPF pension or civil service pension, with household income below eKasih threshold. Distributed monthly via JKM. Source: jkm.gov.my / Bajet 2025.
aids.organisme: Jabatan Kebajikan Masyarakat (JKM) / Kementerian Pembangunan Wanita

aids.description_en: Health screening program for B40 (bottom 40%) households with gross monthly income < MYR 4,000. Free cancer screening, non-communicable disease screening, mental health assessment. Also includes medical device assistance (e.g. hearing aids up to MYR 1,000, glasses MYR 300, prosthetics). Source: pekab40.com.my / moh.gov.my.

MySiswa scholarship for Malaysian students in public universities: up to MYR 5,000/year for eligible low-income students. Covers tuition and living expenses supplement. For students from households with income < MYR 4,000/month. Administered by Ministry of Higher Education. Source: mohe.gov.my.

People's Housing Programme (PPR): subsidized rental housing for urban poor. Monthly rent MYR 124-250/month for 700-900 sqft apartments. For households with monthly income < MYR 2,500. Over 100,000 units in Klang Valley. Applied through JKM/KPKT. Source: kpkt.gov.my.
aids.organisme: Kementerian Perumahan dan Kerajaan Tempatan (KPKT) / JKM

aids.nom: EPF i-Sinar — Retrait EPF en cas de difficulte
aids.description_en: EPF i-Sinar allows EPF members facing financial hardship to withdraw from Account 1 (up to MYR 6,000 lump sum or MYR 500/month for 12 months). For registered contributors with Account 1 savings > MYR 1,000. Reactivated during economic hardship periods. Also: i-Citra, i-Lestari for specific categories. Source: kwsp.gov.my.

aids.nom: Bantuan OKU (Orang Kurang Upaya) — Allocation handicap
aids.description_en: Monthly social assistance for registered persons with disabilities (OKU card holders): MYR 350/month (JKM basic). Additional SOCSO invalidity pension if covered. EPF i-Citra special withdrawal available. JKM also provides assistive devices (wheelchairs, prosthetics up to MYR 5,000). Source: jkm.gov.my / dep.gov.my.
